title: fix(types,components)!: retire grid's flat smColumns / mdColumns / lgColumns / xlColumns; the breakpoint object is the one spelling (objectui#11505)
body:
Fixes #11505
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Dev run for objectui#11505 under the `domain:spec` seat's claim (comment `5961122544`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`. It executes triage's ruling A (comment `5960494324`): the `grid` node's flat `smColumns` / `mdColumns` / `lgColumns` / `xlColumns` channel is retired, and the breakpoint object of `columns` is the one spelling. No alias, no dual spelling, no deprecation window.

Note on spelling: GitHub strips tag-shaped text from bodies, so the SDUI node tag and placeholders below are written as words (GRID-TAG, N, C).

## The accept-set change, key by key

| Surface | Before (base `fcdc8ec9`, measured) | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| strict authoring face (`StrictAnyComponentSchema`) | each key refused at every value as `unrecognized_keys` at the node root | refused at the key's own path, `invalid_type`, with the RETIRED message naming `columns: { md: N }` (per key's breakpoint) |
| tolerant face (`safeValidateSchema`, what `objectui validate` runs) | every value passed through `BaseSchema.passthrough()`, unexamined (`mdColumns: 'wide'` validated) | the same named refusal as the strict face |
| TypeScript face (`GridSchema` in `packages/types/src/layout.ts`) | assignable as `any` through the `BaseSchema` index signature | `?: never` tombstone with a RETIRED docblock, so `tsc` refuses it by name |
| `grid` registration inputs | `columns`, `smColumns`, `mdColumns`, `lgColumns`, `xlColumns`, `gap`, `className`, `children` | `columns`, `gap`, `className`, `children` |
| `grid` registration `defaultProps` | `columns: 1`, `mdColumns: 2`, `lgColumns: 4`, `gap: 4` | `columns: { xs: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }`, `gap: 4` |
| renderer (`grid.tsx`) | read each key over the breakpoint object; any flat key switched off the bare count's mobile-first ramp | reads none of them; a document that reaches it unvalidated draws exactly what it draws without them; never forwarded to the DOM |
| SDUI manifest (`validateTree` over the live registry) | `smColumns: 13` drew `invalid-enum` (registered input) | each key draws a `warning` / `unknown-prop`, "GRID-TAG has no prop" naming the key |

Widening: none. Narrowing: the four keys, which the tolerant face accepted at any value.

`objectui validate`'s printer, read through the CLI's own `validate` command on this branch (a one-off probe, not committed): `{ "type": "grid", "columns": 4, "mdColumns": 2 }` and `{ "type": "grid", "mdColumns": "wide" }` both exit 1 with `Path: mdColumns`, `Code: invalid_type` and the message `RETIRED (objectui#11505, ADR-0049) — mdColumns on grid was a second spelling of the md member of columns: … Instead: write the count, 1 to 12, as the md member of the breakpoint object, columns: { md: N }, and delete the key. A bare columns: C beside it becomes the object's xs: C; with no columns at all, add xs: 2 to keep the two columns the grid drew below md.` The migrated `{ "type": "grid", "columns": { "xs": 4, "md": 2 } }` exits 0.

## Zone 2 readings, measured before trusting them

**H1, the seed renders identically: confirmed.** Through the real `SchemaRenderer`, the base registration's seed (`columns: 1`, `mdColumns: 2`, `lgColumns: 4`, `gap: 4`) drew `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`, and the new seed `columns: { xs: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }` draws the same string. The pin row ("the seeded grid draws the classes the flat seed drew") is green on the base and on this change. The bare `1` never ramps (the ramp needs a count above 1), so the flat overrides had nothing to interact with here.

The migration the refusal prescribes was measured the same way, flat document on the base against the object document on this branch:

| Flat document (base) | Drew on base | Prescribed object | Draws now |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `columns: 1, mdColumns: 2, lgColumns: 4` | `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4` | `{ xs: 1, md: 2, lg: 4 }` | same |
| `columns: 4, mdColumns: 2` | `grid grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4` (ramp switched off) | `{ xs: 4, md: 2 }` | same |
| `smColumns: 3` (no `columns`) | `grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4` | `{ xs: 2, sm: 3 }` | same |
| `columns: { xs: 1, md: 3 }, mdColumns: 2, xlColumns: 6` | `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4` | `{ xs: 1, md: 2, xl: 6 }` | same |
| `columns: 2` and all four flat keys (1, 2, 3, 4) | `grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4` | `{ xs: 2, sm: 1, md: 2, lg: 3, xl: 4 }` | same |

This is why the refusal and the changeset say "a bare `columns: C` becomes `xs: C`" and "with no `columns`, add `xs: 2`": an object without `xs` draws one base column, while an absent `columns` drew two.

**H2, refusal by name on the tolerant face: done as objectui#11465 did, both faces.** Zod: a local `retiredGridColumnsKey(key, breakpoint)` over the house `retirementTombstone`, message `RETIRED (objectui#11505, ADR-0049) — KEY on grid … Instead: …`. TypeScript: `?: never` plus a RETIRED docblock. Measured that the TS half is needed: with `packages/types/src/layout.ts` reverted to the base, `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` in `packages/types` reports 10 errors (4 `Expect` rows, 4 unused `@ts-expect-error` rows, and 2 in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, whose drift ledger catches a zod-only declaration), so without the tombstones `{ type: 'grid', mdColumns: 2 }` compiles.

**H3, producers: the registration was the only one, re-measured.** Census of `\b(sm|md|lg|xl)Columns\b` over every tracked file, plus the lowercase attribute spellings:

| Where | Base | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| renderer reads (`schema.KEY` in `packages/*/src`) | 4, all in `grid.tsx` | 0 |
| registration | 4 inputs and 2 seed keys in `grid.tsx` | 0 (comments only) |
| PageDesigner | none: it seeds a new grid from its own `DEFAULT_PALETTE`, and no designer, shell or console code reads a registration's `inputs` or `defaultProps` (`ComponentRegistry.getConfig` / `getMeta` in `plugin-designer`, `app-shell`, `apps/console`: zero hits) | none |
| `examples/schema-catalog` documents | none | none |
| docs (`content/docs`, `skills/`, READMEs, `apps/site`) | none | two retirement sentences (`grid.mdx`, `schema-reference.md`) |
| tests | `grid-dom-attribute-whitelist.test.tsx` (canary), `layout-spacing-sets-11474.test.tsx` (ledger), one prose line in the catalog's `grid-columns-key.test.tsx` | re-judged below, plus the two new pins |
| scripts | one illustrative comment in `check-component-surface-parity.mjs` | re-pointed at a live intersection spelling |
| objectstack checkout | only `sdui.manifest.json`, the recorded console manifest (see Acceptance notes) | unchanged here |

No corpus document authored a flat key, so none needed fixing.

## Fixtures and documents re-judged

- `grid-dom-attribute-whitelist.test.tsx` (objectui#4787): the canary keeps its four flat keys, re-labelled as retired keys a document that skipped validation still carries; they must still not reach the DOM. Case 1b no longer clears them (they no longer override the object). Case 2's positive control now expects `md:grid-cols-4` (the bare count's ramp) and not `md:grid-cols-2`: the flat `mdColumns: 2` is read by nothing.
- `layout-spacing-sets-11474.test.tsx`: `REGISTERED_NOT_DECLARED` is empty, and its two-way population row now holds it empty; the four `grid.*Columns` positions leave the enumeration because the inputs are gone.
- `examples/schema-catalog/test/grid-columns-key.test.tsx`: its docblock said the registration exposes the five column inputs; it now says `columns` alone.
- `content/docs/components/layout/grid.mdx`, `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`: one sentence each naming the retirement and the object form.
- `scripts/check-component-surface-parity.mjs`: the comment that illustrated the intersection-typed `schema` parameter with the grid's flat-key intersection now cites `UIActionSchema & { actionType?: string }` (`action-button.tsx`), a live one. Comment only; the script's own suite ran (below).

## Pins

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/grid-flat-columns-retired-11505.test.ts`: type level, each key reads `undefined` on both faces and a `@ts-expect-error` per key; runtime, every former value refused at the key's own path on the strict face, the tolerant face and the mirror; the message is the RETIRED one with `Instead:` and `columns: { BP: N }`; the migrated documents parse on both faces; lit controls (the node without the keys parses everywhere, an undeclared key stays green on the tolerant face and is `unrecognized_keys` on the strict one).
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/grid-flat-columns-retired-11505.test.tsx`: the registration's only column input is `columns`; the seed is the breakpoint object with no flat key; the seeded grid draws `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`; each flat key is read by nothing (five shapes); each prescribed object draws what its flat form drew on the base; the SDUI manifest answers each key with `unknown-prop`, and the object form with nothing; a flat key no longer switches the ramp off.

## Reverse verification (committed fix, base restored, then HEAD restored)

From the committed head `4d08cf87`, `grid.tsx`, `zod/layout.zod.ts` and `layout.ts` were checked out from the base `fcdc8ec9` (on-disk check: `retiredGridColumnsKey` 0 hits, the `if (schema.mdColumns)` read 1 hit, `mdColumns?: never` 0 hits) and the four pin files run. Vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src` through the root config's aliases, so no rebuild was involved. Result: `Tests 27 failed | 26 passed (53)`, exit 1. Red: every flat-key row in both new pins (registration, seed shape, read-by-nothing, the manifest rows, the ramp row, the zod refusals), the enumeration ledger row plus the four `grid.*Columns` positions, and whitelist cases 1b and 2. Green on the base, as intended: the seeded-classes row, every migrated-object row, the manifest's object-form control and the lit controls. Restore: `git checkout HEAD --` on the three paths, proved by blob hashes equal to HEAD's and an empty `git diff HEAD`, under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap.

## Pending changesets swept (read as text against what this diff moves)

Each gets a dated, append-only note in the house form:
- `.changeset/11491-grid-columns-set.md`: its components bullet named the four inputs and `validateTree` answering `smColumns: 13` with `invalid-enum`.
- `.changeset/7097-grid-2xl-breakpoint.md`: "the designer's flat `smColumns`…`xlColumns` channel are unchanged".
- `.changeset/8516-8556-mirror-partial-record-narrowing.md` (the card's rider): it says the CLI reports `{ xxl: 6 }` as `Path: columns → xxl`, `Code: invalid_key`. Measured through the CLI's printer on this branch, it reports `Unrecognized key: "xxl"`, `Path: columns`, `Code: unrecognized_keys`, a top-level issue. The note attributes the change to objectui#11073's zod 4.6 resolution, as the rider does; this run measured the present answer, not the transition.
- `.changeset/11441-known-types-retired-layout-keys.md` (the optional rider): its migration line names `gap` with no objectui#11474 note; the note mirrors its sibling's. Every `ResponsiveGrid` gap step (0 to 6 and 8, read off `GAP_CLASSES`) is one of `grid`'s ten.

Left alone, each still true as written:
- `grid-dom-attribute-whitelist-4787.md`: its `mdcolumns` / `smcolumns` are a leak measurement taken at that change.
- `8505-grid-columns-breakpoint-narrowing.md`: it is about the six keys of the `columns` object.
- `11441-retire-nav-responsive-grid-layout.md`: it already carries the objectui#11474 and objectui#11491 notes, and the `columns` object it names is unchanged.
- `11474-layout-spacing-sets.md`: `gap` only.
- `7735-zod-mirrors-stop-authoring-defaults.md`: the `grid.columns` default row is still `let baseCols = 2`.
- `3965-mint-box-neutral-container.md`, `9910-children-slot-declare-and-pin.md`, `6740-flex-is-container.md`, `layout-renderers-dom-props-5574.md`, `dom-leak-sweep-components-5574.md`: grid containment, DOM whitelist and the object spelling, which are unaffected.

New entry: `.changeset/11505-grid-flat-columns-retired.md`, `minor` for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/components`, with the breaking meaning and the migration stated.
